title: Print Glossary Mechanism
description: Add glossary mechanism to print LaTeX stack: GlossaryDefine/Gls usage tracking, Term/Definition/Pages table at end via listofglossaries, replacing unused semioglossary register stub.
summary: Fixed glossary rendering: the Term/Definition/Pages table was empty with all content leaking above it as plain text. Root cause was two-fold in print/tex/semio-table.sty's \SemioTableGlossaryPages: (1) it was wrapped with a runtime \ExplSyntaxOn/\Off inside a \newcommand body defined in normal catcode context, so the expl3 control sequence names it called (e.g. \semio_glossary_pages_render:n) were tokenized with '_'/':' as ordinary characters at definition time and never matched their real csnames, leaving \SemioTableGlossaryPages effectively broken and letting \SemioGlossaryTableRow's arguments spill into the document as plain paragraph text; (2) the page-number dedup logic used \seq_if_in:NnF with an unexpanded tl variable as the comparison item, so duplicates were never detected. Rewrote the whole pages-column pipeline as a small expl3 module defined entirely inside a real \ExplSyntaxOn block (\semio_glossary_page_link:n, \semio_glossary_pages_dedup_add:n, \semio_glossary_pages_render:n, and \SemioTableGlossaryPages itself via \cs_new_protected:Npn), using \seq_if_in:NxF/\seq_put_right:Nx/\tl_put_right:Nx variants (generated via \cs_generate_variant:Nn) so page numbers are compared and deduped by their expanded value. Verified against a clean tectonic build of verify-glossary.tex (3 terms, cross-chapter usages) rendered to PNG: the Glossar table now shows Begriff | Definition | Seiten columns with no leaked text above it, terms sorted alphabetically, page numbers deduplicated per term (e.g. 'Entwurfsfähigkeit' -> 2, 3 instead of 2, 2, 3), and confirmed via pdfjs annotation inspection that all 4 page-number cells carry real hyperlink annotations to their \label destinations. Also re-verified the build against the live, concurrently-edited print/tex/semio-window.sty and semio-table.sty (other agents' in-flight border/layout changes) to confirm the glossary fix is isolated and doesn't conflict.
